answer: A scripted farm as a result has to pad 100 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the quill challenge, the delta audit can replay the nebula history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
